{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Yuma Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/09/24/2026-19581/led-enterprises-llc-notice-of-scoping-period-requesting-comments-on-environmental-issues-for-the|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/yumapipeline|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Maricopa County, Arizona to Yuma County, Arizona.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/09/24/2026-19581/led-enterprises-llc-notice-of-scoping-period-requesting-comments-on-environmental-issues-for-the|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
